title: Dimension-free bounds on entanglement irreversibility and quantum reset capacities
provenance: Same reviewer involved in previous manuscript and dossier audits; exact integrated follow-up, not blind or another independent vote. No subagents.
recommendation_detail: Scientific acceptance; correct the nonblocking Leung author-name erratum.

score_rationale.technical: Valid integrated arguments, correctly paid auxiliary entanglement and seed, public-transcript security, finite decoded coding for infinite-entropy resets, explicit adaptive mean-cost upper bounds, reproducible table and legible 13-page PDF. No material mathematical objection.
score_rationale.importance: An excellent specialized result: dimension-independent absolute irreversibility control for pure/separable mixtures with matching marginal, a uniform bound for every finite identity/EB mixture, and six absolute reset-capacity limits without entropy or energy restrictions on a fixed reset density. Established protocol primitives and close special cases limit novelty; no optimized constant, exact finite-energy capacities or arbitrary mixed-state reversibility is proved.

correctness_confidence.basis: Every integrated theorem checked; no unresolved material objection. Same involved model review, not formal or independent certification.

rigor.basis: Correct factors and conditional-information directions; coherent parity Kraus; finite fixed-A classification; positive finite-state seed, counted bootstrap and security; valid finite/infinite operational separation.

novelty.basis: Substantive plausible absolute dimension-free bounds beyond standard relative isotropic limits; foundational partial-breeding and seed machinery explicitly attributed. Search not exhaustive.

significance.basis: Broad finite-dimensional state and EB-channel applications plus all-density oscillator limits; still specialized, nonoptimal and not an exact finite-energy or general mixed-state solution.

reproducibility.basis: Hashes and manifests verified; identical prior evidence reused; two author scripts newly reproduced; independent 130-digit check of all 24 table entries; all 13 PDF pages viewed.

summary: The exact 13-page manuscript proves the stated matching-marginal dimension-free recovery theorem with no free seed, uses it for arbitrary finite identity/EB mixtures and all fixed oscillator reset densities, and correctly separates operational resource conventions and limits. Scientific acceptance is recommended, with a minor bibliographic author-name correction.
strengths: Stopped classification has bounded entropy and preserves the nonuniform Schmidt coherence via explicit nondestructive Kraus operators.
A paid isotropic seed and slow-block reserve recycling remove external entanglement assistance without assuming a hashing error exponent.
The dimension-free absolute gap applies to arbitrary separable noise with matching marginal and to all finite-dimensional EB channels in an identity mixture.
Six reset-channel capacity asymptotics and explicit state reversibility hold for every fixed trace-class reset density, including infinite entropy or mean energy.
Adaptive mean input energy, complete security environment, order of limits and state-versus-channel cost are distinguished.
Closest known special cases and protocol primitives are acknowledged; finite diagnostics are not presented as operational proofs.
weaknesses: The matching Alice marginal remains a hypothesis of the reviewed finite-state theorem; separability is required for its cost upper bound.
The bound and convergence rate are not optimal, no finite-energy capacity is solved exactly and no efficient implementation is supplied.
Priority search is targeted and underlying coding, filtering, partial breeding and dilution methods are established.
Review is involved model evaluation, not independent human peer review or formal proof verification.

Six absolute high-energy limits and explicit state reversibility for arbitrary fixed reset densities, with no finite entropy or mean energy restriction.
